description: Generates a new image guided by the prompt and 2 chained style-reference image(s) using Krea 2's hosted API Node (Krea 2 Large), via ComfyUI's API Nodes integration. Distinct from the local krea2-style-reference workflow's community LoRA: this is Krea's own model and documents support for up to 10 chained style references with per-reference strength (including negative weights). Requires Krea 2 access separately authorized/credited on your Comfy account.
